notes.title: Demo v0.6: More navigation and controls!
notes.content: [p]This is going to be the last update of the current demo version. Unless some critical bugs occur, I will focus on the actual development of the full game. Maintaining demo version will require too much of a work and time.[/p][p]However, I do plan to release a second version of demo closer to the release. I don't know yet if that's going to be a public demo or a private one with the full game. I guess we will see!![/p][p][/p][p]In this patch:[/p][list][*][p]Navigation compass now has "above" and "below" indicators[/p][/*][*][p]Some tweaking of the controls(mainly roll and pitch)[/p][/*][*][p]Fixing some further bugs with the monsters[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42224373/4094cf7c356a4f438a55e3caf9f6f9169c05a9ef.jpg"][/img][/p][p]However, that does not mean that the controls and navigation are "done". I still have ideas on what I can do more with them and I will continue to experiment[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for your patience! ːChaos_Taashː[/p]

notes.title: Demo v0.5: Fixing things!
notes.content: [p]First of all, thank you so much for everybody who is playing and especially who is giving me feedback! I'm trying to fix all and improve the issues that you helped me found! Thank you! ːLIS_pixel_heartː ːLIS_pixel_heartːːLIS_pixel_heartː[/p][p][/p][p]Fixed:[/p][list][*][p]2nd monster EMP attack has been decreased in cool down and further improved the trigger when the player is near the spawn(also more improvements in this area are coming)[/p][/*][*][p]Removed Social Score dialogues for the demo[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed 3rd boss special missile compass objective pointer[/p][/*][*][p]Added "looking around" function for mouse and right thumbstick[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]What to come:[/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Further improvements with the navigation[/p][/*][*][p]Improvements with the controls[/p][/*][*][p]Improvements with the 2nd boss[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]I removed the social score dialogues for the demo for now, because I just realized that it doesn't make a lot of sense for the player because the whole point of this system will be reveled later down the line, with the non-linear progression[/p]

notes.title: Demo is coming TODAY
notes.content:
Hello everyone,
I'm planning on participating in the June Steam Next Fest of this year.
But before that I would like to publish a demo version of the game so I can get some early feedback.

The demo will consist of 2 levels and will introduce you to the structure of the game.

Of course, as a disclaimer, this is a demo and there will be bugs and other issues.

I would really appreciate your feedback and you being nice, it was quite a long journey to get here 


This will be my first game and my first revel of it to the public, so it's quite scary 	＼(º □ º l|l)/

In any case, thank you all for the support and lets goooooooo
